headline: Apple Photos in iOS 27 adds long-awaited camera roll feature
summary: The 'Captured by Me' feature in iOS 27 aims to replicate the functionality of a traditional camera roll, organizing photos based on where they were taken.
details: Apple's Photos app is set to receive a significant update in iOS 27 with the introduction of the 'Captured by Me' feature.
This new functionality is designed to mimic the experience of a traditional camera roll, allowing users to easily view photos based on their capture location.
Many users have expressed a desire for such a feature, which helps in organizing and recalling photos taken in specific places.
The 'Captured by Me' album will automatically sort images, providing a more intuitive way to browse personal photo libraries.
caption:
iOS 27 is bringing a much-needed camera roll feature to the Apple Photos app.

Apple's Photos app is set to receive a significant update in iOS 27 with the introduction of the 'Captured by Me' feature.

This new functionality is designed to mimic the experience of a traditional camera roll, allowing users to easily view photos based on their capture location.

Many users have expressed a desire for such a feature, which helps in organizing and recalling photos taken in specific places.

The 'Captured by Me' album will automatically sort images, providing a more intuitive way to browse personal photo libraries.
